newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian bonds end down, no early rebound seen.
newsitem.headline: Austrian bonds end down, no early rebound seen.

text.p: Austrian bonds and bond futures continued their downward correction on Tuesday, taking their cue from a weak German market and a softer tone in the U.S.
Traders pinpointed some buying interest in the 30-year period but said the broad market lacked the liquidity to stage an early recovery.
* 10-year benchmark 5.625 pct bond maturing July 2007 down 20 bps at 99.90 to yield 5.64 (5.61) pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 99.64/74 to yield 5.67/5.66 pct.
* Five-year 4.625 bond maturing May 2002 down 20 bps at 99.90 to yield 4.65 (4.60) pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 99.83/91 to yield 4.66/64 percent.
* Austrian bond future down 23 bps at 109.63 on turnover of 68 lots.
* 10-year spread over Germany steady at five bps, five-year spread down one at 17 bps.
* Money market rates higher with three-month VIBOR at 3.397 and overnight money weaker at 3.13/3.38. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 257
